kind: K07 round-7 UX checks of the what-if scenario UI
label: stage1_acf5a7f_with_stage2_test
note: W13b and W14 use a SYNTHETIC fixture engine injected by the test; its numbers are not distances.

checks.expect: scenario mode is off by default: card hidden, a map click creates no scenario item
with the mode on, 3 clicks give 3 control points in the list and on the map
at most 10 control points: the 11th click is refused with a message, the count stays 10

observed.msg: Не больше 10 контрольных точек: удалите одну, чтобы поставить новую.

checks.expect: «Удалить» removes exactly that point from the list and the map
«Переместить» + click moves that point (same id, new coordinates), count unchanged
one proposed object: a second placement moves it (layer shows exactly 1)
deleting the proposed object returns to baseline (no project on map or in the card)

observed.msg: Проектный объект удалён: показан исходный вариант (до).

checks.expect: a click outside the K10 square is refused with a message and changes nothing

observed.msg: Вне квадрата среза (69.5934, 42.3066, 69.6177, 42.3246): не поставлено. Расчёт возможен только внутри сохранённого bbox.

checks.expect: in scenario mode a click on an object marker selects the object and creates no scenario point
«Расстояние от точки» and the scenario mode exclude each other
category change resets the scenario and says why
city switch resets the scenario with a reason; points are not carried to the other city nor restored on return

observed.msg: Сценарий сброшен: смена города — точки не переносятся между городами.

checks.expect: no console or page errors during the mouse path
keyboard only: mode on, centre target shown, Enter places, arrows+Enter place a second point, move via button+Enter, Escape cancels, delete via button, proposed via radio+Enter
no console or page errors during the keyboard path

natural Tab path: from the scenario button to the map in <= 6 Tabs, from the map to the list in <= 8; the map describes the scenario keys (aria-describedby); after «Переместить» focus is on the map, after «Удалить» focus stays in the card (not lost to <body>)

«Отменить перемещение» (reached by Tab from the map) cancels and returns focus to that point's «Переместить»; with the mode off roads and records are back in the Tab order and the map description is removed
no console or page errors during the natural keyboard path
engine strings (SYNTHETIC fixture with markup) are rendered as text: no element created, no handler run
in the other city a point is placed inside that city's square; a click on the scenario's own marker adds nothing
390 px: points placed, placement message visible on the map, no horizontal scroll, all scenario controls inside the screen
390 px with engine rows (SYNTHETIC fixture): every cell inside the card, no horizontal scroll, each value labelled, the no-source caption readable

without an engine the table says the calculation is not connected; with the SYNTHETIC fixture engine rows show before/after/delta, the exact no-source caption and the nearest record's source; at 1400 px (400 px side column) every cell is inside the card
